frozen_analysis_protocol.initial_protocol_timing: Selected after R23 launch started and before any R23 elapsed value was inspected.
frozen_analysis_protocol.later_corrections: The later a5e3a448, 0c7f6d016, e0af8db77 and 88b426497 corrections bind metadata and producer receipt shapes and add arithmetic adversaries. They retain the frozen raw-plan SHA, four arms, 38-row schedule, grouping, Student-t method, tolerances and objective rule.
frozen_analysis_protocol.assumption: The eight paired blocks are treated as independent and roughly symmetric for the two-sided Student-t interval. This small sample remains uncertain; no bootstrap or equivalence inference is made.

independent_recomputation.method: Python standard-library statistics.fmean and statistics.stdev over the 8 scored paired blocks, with the predeclared two-sided t critical value 2.3646242510102993 at df=7.
independent_recomputation.raw_record_checks: All 38 original records have unique sequential ordinals, the frozen schedule labels and arm/block shape, positive finite ordinary-responsive-menu elapsed values at or below the 300-second launch bound, and matching validated nested menu-response values.

outcome.result: No R23 50-percent objective pass is claimed. The direct candidate-minus-published interval is reported independently and does not repair the unresolved percentage denominator or q criterion.

retained_prior_adverse.original_workflow_disposition: The original workflow reader refused actual schema 2 after native preparation. Its adverse chain predates the later direct-successor refusal and is retained without alteration.
retained_prior_adverse.disposition: Neither prior refusal is rewritten as an R23 timing observation or superseded by this completed direct-successor analysis.

next_campaign_proposal.design: A separately frozen R24 may retain the same four arms, configuration, workload, tolerances and 50-percent objective while using 64 counterbalanced scored blocks: 64 scored observations per arm and 262 total launches after four warmups and two same-version A/A records.
next_campaign_proposal.inference: Use df=63 and a two-sided 95-percent Student-t critical value fixed in the R24 declaration (approximately 1.99834); no R23 value is appended, relabelled or reused as an R24 sample.
next_campaign_proposal.budget: Plan a bounded governed 70-to-90-minute same-host run only after a new exact plan/controller review, with a new explicit output budget of approximately 8 GiB. R23's 436-member artifact occupies 1,056,422,548 bytes, so R24 must not inherit a 2 GiB output allowance. This proposal is motivated by R23's d4 interval spanning zero and q upper bound remaining positive, not by any changed threshold or post-hoc rule.

limits: This chain records an endpoint-only R23 observation analysis. It does not qualify release, runtime, memory, active work, client fidelity, saves or general UI behavior.
The analysis retains all raw observations and spread; it does not replace records, select later samples, relax an A/A or drift control, or turn an inconclusive interval into equivalence.
R24 is a proposed separate campaign only. It must be independently predeclared and executed before it can make any new performance claim.
